segments.text: Five border facts that sound fake. Number five is the strangest.
One. Point Roberts is a US town you can only drive to through Canada.
Two. Nobody agrees where the border is on Lake Constance. Three countries share it anyway.
Three. In Baarle, the border runs right through houses. Your front door decides your country.
Four. The Diomede Islands are less than four kilometers apart, but twenty one hours apart in time.
Five. Pheasant Island is Spanish for six months, then French for six months. Since sixteen fifty nine.
Which one did you not believe? Tell me in the comments.
